The '''personal Soul Tree''' of [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]] was located in the vicinity of the [[Warrick family hut]], in the [[Happy Grove/Legends|Happy Grove]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. Wile he was still a [[Wokling/Legends|Wokling]], Warrick spent one whole day sitting his [[Soul Tree]] after an argument with his older brother [[Weechee Warrick|Weechee]].
